mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workout_templates ( id, owner_user_id, source_workout_id, name, body_part, equipment_snapshot, status ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{ownerUserId}::uuid, #{sourceWorkoutId}::uuid, #{name}, #{bodyPart}::on_demand_body_part_enum, #{equipmentSnapshot, typeHandler=com.fitness.config.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{status}::workout_template_status_enum )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workout_templates WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}::uuid
SELECT * FROM workout_templates WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}::uuid ORDER BY updated_at DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT te.id AS template_exercise_id, te.template_id, te.exercise_id, te.sequence, te.sets, te.reps, te.load, te.load_type, te.rpe, te.created_at, e.name AS exercise_name, e.body_part AS exercise_body_part, e.target AS exercise_target, e.equipment AS exercise_equipment, e.gif_url AS exercise_gif_url, e.image_url AS exercise_image_url, e.coach_cue AS exercise_coach_cue, e.coach_cue_en AS exercise_coach_cue_en, e.is_active AS exercise_active FROM workout_template_exercises te JOIN exercises e ON e.id = te.exercise_id WHERE te.template_id = #{templateId}::uuid ORDER BY te.sequence
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workout_templates WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}::uuid
mapper.update: UPDATE workout_templates SET name = #{name}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}::uuid AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE workout_template_exercises te SET sequence = #{exercise.sequence}, sets = #{exercise.sets}, reps = #{exercise.reps}, load = #{exercise.load}, load_type = #{exercise.loadType}::load_type_enum, rpe = #{exercise.rpe} WHERE te.id = #{exercise.templateExerciseId}::uuid AND te.template_id = #{templateId}::uuid AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workout_templates wt WHERE wt.id = te.template_id AND wt.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}::uuid )
